headline: Uganda signs crude oil marketing deal with Vitol ahead of first exports
summary: Uganda has signed a crude oil marketing agreement with energy trader Vitol as commercial production preparations enter their final stages. President Museveni witnessed the signing, which paves the way for crude exports.
why: Vitol is one of the world's largest independent energy traders, marketing physical crude and refined products across global markets. Export deals like this determine how a producer's new oil reaches international buyers.
